BiblicalUsage: The word names a girdle, and Isaiah uses it once, in the stripping of the proud daughters of Zion: instead of sweet smell there shall be stink, and instead of a girdle a rent, and instead of well set hair baldness, and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the girdle torn away is the sign of a beauty that was worn for show, and God strips what pride has dressed.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
